_comment: Block atlas manifest — read at startup by client/src/block_atlas.rs.
This file is the ENTIRE contract between the art set and the engine.
To ship a new set: drop 16x16 PNGs in this folder, then edit `tiles` (name
-> file) and `kinds` (block kind -> which tile each face wears). No Rust
change, no rebuild. `tile_px` may change too, as long as it is even.
Tiles are packed with a wrapped gutter, so every tile must be SEAMLESS.
Face keys: `all` sets top+side+bottom; `top`/`side`/`bottom` override it.
Art set + hue rationale: see PALETTE.md (Monanisa, 2026-08-17).
